title: A Higher Nominal Growth World Brings Higher Volatility, Says Jim Caron
title_cn: 吉姆·卡伦表示，更高的名义增长世界会带来更高的波动性
summary:
Market and policymaker discourse over the next move for the Fed is split: One camp believes the central bank needs to assert its commitment to price stability by hiking in September, particularly to recover some of Chairman Kevin Warsh’s inflation-fighting credibility. 
Another thinks that price gains are on the way down and the Fed is correct to stay its current course.
Jim Caron, CIO of Cross Asset Solutions at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, discusses the shift toward higher nominal growth and how the Fed is set to respond to this week's inflation data. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Soft US Jobs Cast Doubt on September Fed Hike
title_cn: 美国就业疲软引发对美联储 9 月加息的质疑
summary: Jennifer McKeown, Chief Global Economist at Capital Economics, discussed the implications of the recent US labor market report on Federal Reserve interest rate expectations. The report showed a decline in payrolls alongside a drop in the unemployment rate, presenting a mixed picture. Wage growth at 3.2% was softer than expected, which may reduce the likelihood of an imminent rate hike in September. McKeown emphasized that the upcoming July CPI data and the next payroll report before the September Fed meeting will be critical in shaping policy decisions. She also highlighted concerns about the falling labor force participation rate, questioning whether this reflects structural issues or a mismatch between job quality and worker preferences. Overall, the segment underscored market uncertainty ahead of key inflation data that will influence the Fed's next moves. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Brings Powerful AI to the Personal Computer
title_cn: Meta 为个人电脑带来强大的人工智能
summary: Meta is escalating the debate over open versus closed AI with Muse Glimmer, a new downloadable model designed to run on a personal computer using a single GPU. The release, accompanied by a new essay from CEO Mark Zuckerberg, underscores Meta's push for more accessible and customizable AI as low-cost open models from China intensify pressure on rivals including OpenAI and Anthropic. Bloomberg's Kurt Wagner joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: South Park Commons Raises Ambitions for the AI Era
title_cn: South Park Commons 提出人工智能时代的雄心
summary: South Park Commons is expanding its investment strategy as AI pushes founders toward increasingly ambitious and capital-intensive ideas. Co-founder and General Partner Aditya Agarwal joins Bloomberg to discuss the firm’s “minus one to zero” approach to backing entrepreneurs before their ideas fully take shape, why its new fund will allow it to write bigger checks and invest for longer, and how early bets on founders like Cognition CEO Scott Wu are shaping its strategy. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: From Coding to Finance: Microsoft’s AI Agent Push
title_cn: 从编码到金融：微软的AI代理推送

Charles Lamanna, Microsoft EVP of Copilot, Agents and Platform, joins Bloomberg to explain how employees are shifting from doing tasks themselves to overseeing AI agents, why the company sees the technology driving more productivity rather than simply reducing headcount, and what’s behind Microsoft 365 Copilot’s surge past 30 million paid seats. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: GameStop Rethinks Its eBay Play

They join Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Intel Raises Cash, Apple Gets Downgraded | Bloomberg Tech 8/10/2026

title: How Can China Win the AI Race Against the US?

Paulina McPadden, investment manager of International Concentrated Growth Strategy at Baillie Gifford, discusses why she “wouldn’t want to bet against China” and the durable moats she sees at TSMC, SK Hynix and ASML. She also discusses how companies like Shopify and MercadoLibre are emerging as AI beneficiaries outside the semiconductor industry. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: A lavish Harare wedding attended by the president shows the political clout wielded by tycoons.

title: Iran Says It's Nearing Strait of Hormuz Deal With Oman
title_cn: 伊朗表示即将与阿曼达成霍尔木兹海峡协议
summary: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi ruled out direct talks with the US for now, but said a pact with Oman to establish a shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz was “very close.” Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jharkhand Student Protesters March Over Compromised Government Job Exams
title_cn: 贾坎德邦学生抗议者因政府工作考试受损而游行
summary: India’s student-led protests continue in the eastern state of Jharkhand over alleged exam irregularities, even as demonstrations in New Delhi have subsided following the education minister’s resignation.

title: China Slams India for Naming Sites in Disputed Border Region
title_cn: 中国谴责印度在有争议的边境地区命名地点
summary: China condemned India for formally announcing names for 27 sites in a disputed border region, escalating a spat just as the two sides seek to stabilize ties after years of border tensions.

title: Estonian Cabinet Loses Majority Seven Months Ahead of Elections
title_cn: 爱沙尼亚内阁在选举前七个月失去多数席位
summary: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal lost majority support for his cabinet after two members of parliament defected in quick succession, complicating his leadership with seven months to go before a regular general election.
